betaDescription: Play Preferans, the classic trick-taking card game, with bots or friends. This beta focuses on public tables, room-code invitations, reconnect recovery and final match scores. Use build 30 on every test device to play together on the updated server.
betaReviewNotes: Build 1.0.3 (30) tests the updated owner-hosted multiplayer service. No purchased subscription or demo credentials are needed. Open Play online, enter a display name and tap Continue as Guest (Sign in with Apple is also available). Choose Create a table, or Find a table to join another device running build 30. Players mark Ready before the first deal. Local bot play is also available. Focus: public creation/join, reconnection after backgrounding, starting the next deal when the table manager is offline, and final balances in game history. Settings contains account deletion and legal links.
